title: Keys Rename — payload
description: Change a key's identifier. The key material is untouched — only the name it is addressed by changes.

keyId.description: The identifier the key is addressed by today.

newKeyId.description: The identifier it should be addressed by afterwards. MUST NOT collide with an existing record.

Response.title: Keys Rename — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/rename request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/rename/0.1#response.

keyId.description: The identifier now in effect — the request's `newKeyId`.
